name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted job search workspace that keeps one career profile, drafts tailored resumes and cover letters with AI and tracks every application, backed by PostgreSQL.

alerts.message: Sign in with the generated DOSSIER_LOGIN_PASSWORD from this app's environment settings. To change it, edit that value and redeploy; every restart signs you out.
Drafting resumes and cover letters needs an AI provider. After signing in, set one under Settings, AI provider: an API key for a hosted model or the URL of a model server you run.
